# Qwen coverage

Every Qwen model OpenRouter serves, as of 2026-09-22. A tick means this benchmark has run it.

The **run cost** column prices a full 360-item run using the token counts measured on the first completed run. Thinking models will exceed it, often by a lot — treat it as a floor.

## Why the untried ones were left out

Not an oversight — each group was skipped for a reason:

**No tool calling.** The benchmark *is* a tool call, so these cannot run at all.

**Vision variants (`-vl-`).** Same weights plus a vision tower, and every prompt in this task is text. Running them re-measures the text model at a higher price.

**Coder variants.** Tuned for code, while the task is general facts and conversation. One is included as a control; the rest would score badly for reasons that say nothing about tool judgement.

**Dated snapshots.** `qwen-plus-2025-07-28` and `qwen3.5-plus-02-15` are point-in-time copies of models already covered.

**The max tier.** Not wrong, just expensive, and its members move together. Worth adding one if a ceiling is wanted.

To add any of them: put a `ModelSpec` in `src/llmsearchbench/providers/registry.py` with the price from the table above, then rerun this script to update the ticks.
